title: Features · 3-card horizontal grid
description: H2 + 3 lede paragraphs + 3 horizontal cards. Each card carries a mono number badge, a title, and two body paragraphs. Used as the 'Connected Operations' / 'How the platform Works' framing pattern. 3 fixed slots (use features.accordion-2col-numbered for variable counts).

source.adapted_from: v5 dark + v4 light → unified light tokens
source.decision: PM lock 2026-05-21 — 3-card framing pattern = v5 horizontal layout

gradient.recommended: subtle neutral/accent gradient only; do not use freeform decorative orbs

notes: Background is decorative and must not replace content media slots or block copy.
Preview in any supported harness with ?bg=gradient or ?bg=image&bgImage=<encoded-url>.

notes: 3 fixed cards by design — variant count is baked into the block name. Use features.accordion-2col-numbered for variable counts.
Cards have a hover lift; useful even on touch as feedback when navigating to a deeper page.
Eyebrow and number badges use --cta-secondary-fill / --cta-secondary-color so this section follows the same palette as secondary CTAs.
At ≤980px the section collapses to a single column.
